Sam (AE): Heads up — BigBank wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Main asks: signed USB delivery, SBOM, offline cert rotation, and a documented upgrade cadence. They want it run over 2 weeks. Thoughts?
Priya (SE): We can cover that but need clear assumptions. Suggested flow: seed image (operator + runtime) on USB, then minibundle deltas (rsync/diff) for security patches, plus one offline cert rotation exercise.
Morgan (Ops): Chain-of-custody is a hard ask. We should provide timestamped signatures + signed SBOM. HSM signing ideal; if not available, we provide documented KMS fallback. Recommend minibundles <= 4GB for USB.
Ava (PM): Commercial note: sealed packaging and custom signing are billable. Recommend one-time engineering prep fee + per-bundle signing/validation fee; 24/7 cutover support is an add-on. I'll put ranges in the scoping note.
Sam (AE): They also asked about upgrade cadence: quarterly security patches and up to 2 major upgrades/year. Can we commit for the POC?
Priya (SE): Yes to quarterly deltas during the POC. Major upgrades twice a year is feasible but needs a planned compatibility window. Hotpatch/no-reboot is more complex and should be optional.
Morgan (Ops): Preflight we ask their infra person to run: kernel/driver min versions, disk/GPU footprint, presence of root CA or signing key, and verification commands. Provide this snippet: ```# verify bundle
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify vendor_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
```
sig-bot: artifact uploaded: bigbank-airgap-2024-11-20 (signed). Manifest + sbom attached.
Priya (SE): Security questionnaire attachments: airgap-runbook.pdf, signed-sbom.json, minibundle-manifest-example.json, offline-rotation-script.sh, plus the sample commands.
Ava (PM): Risks to flag in SOW: third-party SCAP scans in sealed envs may add 2-5 days; lack of external time sources needs an internal TSA or embedded timestamps; requests for hotpatching add scope.
Sam (AE): Pricing question: customer asked for weekend on-call during cutover. Ava, include ranges and mark final pricing subject to SOW signoff.
Ava (PM): Will do. Action items: Priya -> 1-page scoping + acceptance criteria; Morgan -> chain-of-custody appendix + preflight checklist; I'll add commercial ranges and risk appendix. Drop by EOD PT.
Priya (SE): Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Seed install succeeds on >=1 host; 2) Signed minibundle applies & verifies (manifest+sig); 3) Offline cert rotation executed & validated; 4) SBOM + signed provenance delivered; 5) Runbook handed off with 1 live walkthrough.
Morgan (Ops): Also include rollback steps and a named ops contact on their side. If their network blocks NTP, include timestamp guidance in runbook.
Sam (AE): Perfect. I'll prep legal sync for sealed-delivery SOW once doc is in. :thumbsup:
